ownerStatement: The languages so far that are one hundred percent done; the others are also done but not confirmed. This list is fully confirmed from the owner's side: Java, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Kotlin, Scala. All analyzers onboard after M37/M14 are done fully; M14 is the king of the analyzer work. The program targets 42 analyzers (42 languages) in the future.

futureWaves.policy: Remaining analyzers onboard in later waves once M37/M14 completes; each wave runs the same M29.R1 protocol.
futureWaves.wave2Decision: Owner confirmed 2026-09-04: keep wave 1's six languages; onboard the remaining registry languages in bulk waves only after M37/M14 is fully done. No interim per-language waves unless the owner orders one.

gitStrategy: Continue local; sync with origin/main deferred as an owner-level decision (169 unpushed commits spanning M24-M29; upstream is 7 commits ahead on co-agent M37/M35 lanes with no M29 overlap; a rebase replay collides with co-agent lane rewrites).
evidenceRule: The R2 verifier executes exactly this set and nothing else; any language not in this list that attempts a wave leg fails the verifier.
